# Saturday Walk-in Live Scan (California)

> California Live Scan shops that the DOJ list marks as Saturday walk-in, city by city.

Confirm hours and fees with the shop before you go. DOJ says the public list can be stale. Nobody listed here was called.

## Pages

- [Saturday Walk-in Live Scan (California)](https://saturdaylivescan.com/): Index of California cities with DOJ-listed Saturday walk-in Live Scan shops. Includes FAQ.
- [Saturday cash Live Scan in Oakland](https://saturdaylivescan.com/oakland-saturday-cash-live-scan/): DOJ-listed shops, hours, rolling fees, skip list, FAQ on the city page.
